Confirmed: `runningJob` is never assigned — the "Stop" button only calls `onStopRequested()` (stop TTS/auto-read) and sets loading=false, but does not cancel the in-flight AI request. That's an important finding for whoever adds streaming (cancellation must actually work).

Now compose the final report.

## 1. In‑reader AI chat overlay UI

**File: `/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code/app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/presentation/reader/components/ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt`** (1090 lines) — the only in‑reader chat surface. Mounted from `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/ui/reader/ReaderActivity.kt:1298-1313`.

### State (all local `remember` state, no ViewModel/StateFlow)
| Line | State | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:116` | `val history = remember { mutableStateListOf<Msg>() }` | **the only place a reply can live** — a `SnapshotStateList<AiHistoryManager.Msg>` |
| `:117` | `var loading by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }` | agent turn in flight |
| `:118` | `var input` | text field |
| `:122-123` | `var activity`, `var elapsed` | status line text + seconds counter |
| `:143` | `var runningJob by remember { mutableStateOf<Job?>(null) }` | **never assigned** (see below) |
| `:148` | `var queuedMessage: Pair<String, ByteArray?>?` | message typed while busy |

### Send path
`ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:216-241`
```kotlin
val send: (String, String?, ByteArray?) -> Unit = { text, fileName, fileBytes ->
    if (text.isNotBlank() && !loading) {
        input = ""
        sendMessage(context = context, scope = scope, …, history = history,
            loading = { loading = it }, onScroll = scrollTo,
            censorship = bookSettings.censorship, historyChannel = historyChannel,
            onActivity = setActivity, onDone = { sessionRefresh += 1 })
```
Entry points: IME `onSend` (`:566-570`) and the send icon (`:573-578`) → `sendOrQueue` (`:245-261`).

### How the assistant reply is rendered — **all‑or‑nothing, no incremental rendering**
`ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:441-496` — plain `LazyColumn` + `itemsIndexed(history)`:
```kotlin
itemsIndexed(history) { index, msg ->
    ChatBubble(context, msg, isMine = msg.role == "user", canPlay = msg.role == "ai", …)
}
```
`ChatBubble` (`:836-1013`) renders `msg.text` as a single `Text` (`:885-890`):
```kotlin
SelectionContainer { Text(msg.text, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium) }
```
plus collapsible `msg.reasoning` (`:869-884`), `msg.choices` buttons (`:891-910`), `msg.tools` (`:911-928`), `msg.files` (`:929-971`), and a footer with `msg.model` / `msg.tokens` (`:972-994`).

### The whole turn is one blocking call, then one append
`ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:625-713` (`sendMessage`):
```kotlin
645: AiHistoryManager.append(context, history, Msg(role = "user", text = input), mangaId, historyChannel)
646: loading(true)
647: onActivity("Запрос к модели…")
648: scope.launch {
649:   val reply = runCatching { chatOnce(… onProgress = onActivity) }.getOrElse { … "Сбой запроса к AI: …" }
672:   val shown = if (censorship) BookChatProfile.maskCensored(reply.text) else reply.text
680:   AiHistoryManager.append(context, history, msg = Msg(role = "ai", text = shown, … ), mangaId, channel)
708:   loading(false)
710:   onScroll(history.size - 1)
```
* There is **no placeholder assistant message** and **no partial text state**: the AI `Msg` is created at `:680-707` *after* `chatOnce` returned the complete `AgentReply`.
* The only thing shown while waiting is a spinner + status text (`:416-438`) fed by `activity` / `onProgress`:
  `append(if (loading) "AI думает" else "Готово"); if (elapsed > 0) append(" · ").append(elapsed).append(" с"); if (activity.isNotBlank()) …`
* `chatOnce` (`:734-816`) builds the prompt and calls the agent:
```kotlin
754:  val resolution = AiBackends.resolve(context, backendId = orchestrator.backendId, modelOverride = orchestrator.modelOverride)
759:  val chat = resolution.chat
806:  AiAgent.run(context, userText = prompt, attachmentsInfo = attachedText, history = priorTurns,
               chatFn = chat, mangaId = mangaId, bookContext = knowledge, onProgress = onProgress)
```
* **Stop is a no‑op for the request**: `runningJob` is only ever read/cleared, never assigned — `:143` declares it, `:267-268` cancels it. Real cancellation only happens via `onStopRequested()` (TTS/auto‑read, `ReaderActivity.kt:1308-1311`). Note `AiAssistant.chatRawOutcome` is a *blocking* non‑suspend function, so even assigning `runningJob` would not interrupt the socket read.

Streaming notes for later work: `AiHistoryManager.Msg` is an immutable `@Serializable data class` (`AiHistoryManager.kt:30-42`), and `AiHistoryManager.append` **writes the whole JSON file on every call** (`AiHistoryManager.kt:111-133`, `save` at `:101-109`) — so per‑chunk updates must mutate the in‑memory list (`history[last] = msg.copy(text = …)`) and persist once at the end.

---

## 2. Network layer: `AiAssistant.kt` / `AiBackends.kt` / `AiPlugins.kt` / `AiAgent.kt`

### Transport: `HttpURLConnection`, body read fully in one shot — no SSE, no `stream: true`
`/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code/app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/ai/AiAssistant.kt`
* `:15-18` imports `java.net.HttpURLConnection`, `java.net.URL`, `Proxy` (no OkHttp/Ktor in the AI layer).
* `:183-211 openConnection(url: String): HttpURLConnection` — routes through the app's HTTP/SOCKS proxy from `NetworkPreferences`.
* `:482-579 chatRawOutcome(url, model, apiKey, userPrompt, systemPrompt, maxTokens): Outcome` — **the single place a chat HTTP request is made**:
```kotlin
505: val conn = openConnection(actualUrl)
506: conn.requestMethod = "POST"
508: conn.connectTimeout = 15_000
509: conn.readTimeout = 90_000
513: conn.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toString().toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
514: val code = conn.responseCode
515: val text = (if (code in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream)
516:     ?.use { it.readBytes().toString(Charsets.UTF_8) }.orEmpty()   // ← whole body, one shot
...
555: val parsed = ZenProtocol.parse(text, model)
```
* `:447-461 sealed class Outcome { Ok, RateLimited, Transient, Fatal, FreeTierBlocked }` — retry/rotation classification; `:469-473 isZenFreeTierBlocked(code, body)`.
* `:100-141 customProviderChat(spec, userPrompt, systemPrompt, maxTokens, modelOverride)` — user‑declared OpenAI‑compatible providers, same `chatRawOutcome`.

### Exact signatures the UI ultimately calls
```kotlin
// AiAssistant.kt:260-268
data class ChatReply(content, reasoning, model, tokens: Int = 0, complete: Boolean = true)

// AiAssistant.kt:275-276
suspend fun chat(userPrompt: String, systemPrompt: String? = null, maxTokens: Int = 500): String?

// AiAssistant.kt:285-290

                     maxTokens: Int = 500, modelOverride: String? = null): ChatReply?
```
`chatFull` body is `withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { … }` (`:291`) → `:299-304` custom provider, `:307-350` OpenRouter (+ Zen fallback), `:354` `zenChatWithRotation` (`:371-432`, per‑model rotation, cooldowns in `modelCooldownUntil` `:143`).

### The chat function type the agent consumes
`/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code/app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/ai/AiBackends.kt`
```kotlin
81: typealias ChatFn = suspend (prompt: String, system: String) -> ChatReply?
87-93: data class Resolution(backendId, chat: ChatFn?, message: String? = null) { val ready get() = chat != null }
279-327: fun resolve(context, backendId, state = state(context), maxTokens = DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS /*1800*/, modelOverride): Resolution
   // :297 LocalLlm.chat(...)  :313 RunnerLlm.chat(...)  :324 AiAssistant.chatFull(prompt, system, maxTokens, modelOverride)
330: const val DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 1800
```

`/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code/app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/ai/AiAgent.kt`
```kotlin
235-244: suspend fun run(context, userText, attachmentsInfo = null, history: List<Pair<String,String>> = emptyList(),
                          chatFn: (suspend (String, String) -> AiAssistant.ChatReply?)? = null,
                          mangaId: Long? = null, bookContext: String? = null,
                          onProgress: ((String) -> Unit)? = null): AgentReply
327:     var reply = reliableChat(chat, prompt, systemPromptEffective) ?: …     // 3 attempts + 2 max_tokens continuations (202-233)
454-467: stripToolSyntax → parseChoices → AgentReply(cleanText, results, images, reasoning, model, tokens, tookMs, rounds, choices)
```
* `onProgress` (`:243`) is the **only** callback and it carries **status strings, never content**: `:323 "Запрос к модели…"`, `:390 "Инструменты: …"`, `:409-419` per‑tool summary, `:425 "Инструменты выполнены, жду ответ модели…"`.
* The agent loop (`:363-452`) can call the model up to 12 rounds; each round is another full `reliableChat` call, i.e. a *stream* would fire per round.

### Response format parsing — centralized in `ZenProtocol`
`/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code/app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/ai/ZenProtocol.kt`
```kotlin
29-44:  enum class Family(val endpoint: String) { CHAT("/chat/completions"), RESPONSES("/responses"), MESSAGES("/messages"), GEMINI(""), SYSTEM_ONE("/systemone") }
53-63:  fun familyOf(model: String): Family
66-72:  fun urlFor(baseUrl, model): String
75-147: fun requestBody(model, userPrompt, systemPrompt, maxTokens): JsonObject
            // :144   put("stream", false)     ← the only `stream` field in the chat request; explicitly OFF
150-155: data class Parsed(content, reasoning, tokens, complete)
163-167: fun textOrNull(element): String?
174-185: fun parse(body: String, model: String): Parsed          ← THE single entry point
209-222: private fun parseChat(root)        // choices[0].message.content + reasoning|reasoning_content

252-270: private fun parseMessages(root)    // content[] {text | thinking|redacted_thinking} / stop_reason
272-289: private fun parseGemini(root)       // candidates[0].content.parts[] , thought-flag split
```
`ZenProtocol.parse` is pure and unit‑tested (`app/src/test/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/ai/ZenProtocolTest.kt`). **Caveat for streaming:** it parses *complete* responses only — it reads `message.content`, never `choices[].delta.content`; there is no `data: [DONE]` / `response.output_text.delta` / `content_block_delta` handling anywhere.

---

## 3. Does anything else in the app already stream?

**No SSE / no token streaming anywhere.** Evidence:
* Repo‑wide grep for `text/event-stream`, `event-stream`, `EventSource`, `StreamSource`, `bodyAsChannel`, `ByteReadChannel`, `Flow<ByteReadChannel>` → **zero matches** in `*.kt`.
* `"stream"` appears exactly 3 times, always as `false`:
  * `app/.../data/ai/ZenProtocol.kt:144` (chat request)
  * `data/src/main/java/mihon/data/ocr/ZenFreeOcrEngine.kt:31` and `:107` (OCR + `askAboutPage`)
* `"data: "` / `event:` → zero in `*.kt`; the npm‑hub `data:` hits are WebSocket JSON payloads (`npm-hub/src/server.js:1068`, `npm-hub/public/desktop-app.js:711`), not SSE.
* `Flow<String>`: none. Closest existing progressive APIs (all coarse, none text‑content):
  * STT partials: `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/ui/overlay/GameSttManager.kt:39` `var onPartial: ((String) -> Unit)?` → `:133-137` `onPartialResults` → consumed at `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/ui/overlay/OcrOverlayService.kt:372` `it.onPartial = { part -> setBubble(part) }`
  * TTS utterance callbacks: `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/tts/TtsSpeaker.kt:346-351`, `:664-668`, `:766-769` (`UtteranceProgressListener.onStart/onDone`)
  * OCR OkHttp **WebSocket** push (OCR only, not chat): `data/src/main/java/mihon/data/ocr/OwOcrEngine.kt:100-124` (`onOpen`/`onMessage`/`onFailure`)
  * Byte‑progress callback: `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/ai/LocalLlm.kt:368,389` `exportTarXz(…, onProgress: (Float) -> Unit)`
  * Local HTTP server chat is also blob‑based: `app/.../data/ai/AiHttpServer.kt:142-150` (`POST /chat` → `runBlocking { AiAgent.run(...) }`) and its HTML/JS client at `:501-512` (`await r.json()` then `w.innerHTML=h`), `respond(...)` writes `Content-Length` + single `flush()` at `:453-472`.
* `PanelDetectionRepositoryImpl.parseDetectionChunk` (`:399`, `:414`) is tensor‑stride chunking, not streaming.
* **Available for a streaming implementation:** OkHttp 5.4.0 is already on the app classpath — `gradle/libs.versions.toml:67,181-188,238` and `app/build.gradle.kts:315 implementation(libs.bundles.okhttp)` (mockwebserver for tests at `app/build.gradle.kts:376`). Ktor is not in the version catalog.

---

## 4. Chat models / backends catalogue, and parser reuse potential

**Backends** (`AiBackends.kt`): `BACKEND_ONLINE = "online"` (`:70`), `BACKEND_LOCAL = "local"` (`:71`), `BACKEND_RUNNER = "runner"` (`:72`); plugins `ONLINE` "Онлайн (Zen / OpenRouter)" (`:115-123`), `LOCAL` "Локальная LLM" (`:125-133`, `supportsModelChoice = false`), `RUNNER` "Полу-онлайн (GitHub Runner)" (`:135-148`); `ALL` at `:150`, `byId` `:152`, requirements enum `AiRequirement` `:15-33`, `state()` `:211-229`, `statusOf()` `:161-208`, `route()` `:238-268`.

**Providers** (`AiAssistant.kt:37-46`): `PROVIDER_ZEN = "zen"`, `PROVIDER_OPENROUTER = "openrouter"`, `ZEN_BASE_URL = "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1"`, `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"`. User providers in `AiProviders.kt:39-49` (`Spec(id,title,baseUrl,model,apiKey)`), `builtIn()` `:100-117`, `chatCompletionsUrl()` `:74-79`, reserved ids `:52-55`.

**Model catalogue**
* `AiAssistant.ZEN_MODELS` (`AiAssistant.kt:62-70`): `mimo-v2.6-flash-free`, `mimo-v2.5-free`, `nemotron-3.5-lightning-free`, `nemotron-3-ultra-free`, `big-pickle`, `space-bunny-free`, `ling-3.0-flash-fin-free`
* `AiAssistant.OPENROUTER_FREE_FALLBACK` (`:73-79`): `nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b:free`, `poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free`, `z-ai/glm-5.2:free`, `google/gemma-4-31b-it:free`, `nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free`; live list via `fetchOpenRouterFreeModels()` (`:242-257`)
* Roles: `AiModelRoles.kt:12-16` `AiRole { OCR, CHAT, ORCHESTRATOR }`, `chatTarget` `:59-69`, `orchestratorTarget` `:76-122`, `statusLines` `:125-137`; prefs `pref_ai_provider/ai_backend/ai_orchestrator_*/zen_model/openrouter_free_model/ai_auto_rotate` in `domain/src/main/java/mihon/domain/ocr/service/OcrPreferences.kt:215,234,240,243,270,274,280` (no streaming‑related pref exists).
* Per‑reader model label helper: `ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:720-732 chatModelLabel(...)`.

**Parser centralization:** yes — one function, `ZenProtocol.parse(body, model)` (`ZenProtocol.kt:174-185`), dispatching on `familyOf(model)` to 4 private parsers (`:209`, `:224`, `:252`, `:272`), plus one request builder `ZenProtocol.requestBody(...)` (`:75-147`) and one URL builder `urlFor` (`:66-72`). For per‑chunk streaming you would reuse `requestBody`/`urlFor` unchanged and add a *delta* parser next to `parse` (the existing parsers cannot be reused verbatim, since they read `message.content` / full `output[]` / full `content[]` rather than `choices[].delta` / `response.output_text.delta` / `content_block_delta` / Gemini `parts[].text` appends). Exception: `RunnerLlm.chat` (`RunnerLlm.kt:670-671`) parses inline with `org.json` and is a second, independent parser.

Note the bus carries **no text content**, only a stage + a note string.

**Chapter/batch progress (app layer, callback based)** — `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/ocr/OcrChapterScanner.kt:29-34`:
```kotlin
suspend fun scanChapter(chapterId, …,
    onProgress: (OcrChapterScanProgress) -> Unit,
    onComplete: (OcrChapterScanProgress) -> Unit,
    onError: (OcrChapterScanError) -> Unit,
    onCacheStateChanged: (chapterId: Long, hasResults: Boolean) -> Unit = { _, _ -> })
```
`OcrChapterScanProgress` `:209-216` (`processedPages`/`totalPages`, per‑page updates at `:128-129`), `OcrChapterScanError` `:218-224`, `OcrScanFailure` `:226-234`; driven by `OcrScanManager.runPendingQueue()` `app/.../OcrScanManager.kt:201-260` (`onProgress/onComplete/onError/onCacheStateChanged` at `:218-240`, `OcrQueueStatus` `:429-432`).

### (b) Per‑region / segment recognition

**Public (domain) API is whole‑page only** — `domain/src/main/java/mihon/domain/ocr/repository/OcrRepository.kt`:
```kotlin
7:  suspend fun recognizeText(image: OcrImage): String
18: suspend fun askAboutImage(image: OcrImage, question: String): String?
20-24: suspend fun scanPage(chapterId, pageIndex, image): OcrPageResult
26-29: suspend fun getCachedPage(chapterId, pageIndex): OcrPageResult?
31-45: getCachedChapterIds / clearCachedChapter / clearCache / getCacheSizeBytes / withScanSession / cleanup
```
**No callback, no Flow, no per‑region entry point** on the interface. Interactors: `domain/.../ocr/interactor/ScanPageOcr.kt:10-16 await(chapterId, pageIndex, image): OcrPageResult`, `OcrProcessor.kt`, `WithOcrScanSession.kt`, `GetCachedPageOcr.kt`, `ClearCachedChapterOcr.kt`, `ClearOcrCache.kt`, `GetOcrCacheSize.kt`.

**Per‑region recognition exists only internally** in `data/src/main/java/mihon/data/ocr/OcrRepositoryImpl.kt` (1020 lines):
* `class OcrRepositoryImpl(context) : OcrRepository` — `:33-35`; all public overrides are whole‑page: `recognizeText :369`, `askAboutImage :386`, `scanPage :406-468`, cache ops `:470-496`, `withScanSession :498-511`, `cleanup :908-915`. No `override` takes a callback.
* The **per‑box loop** lives in `private suspend fun scanLocally(...)` `:744-880` — this is the natural hook point for per‑region streaming:
```kotlin
808: val regions = usableBoxes.mapIndexedNotNull { index, box ->
809:     val crop = cropBitmap(image, box) ?: return@mapIndexedNotNull null
819:     val text = submitTask(PrioritizedTaskQueue.Priority.NORMAL) {
820:         engineLocks.withTextEngineLock(type) {
822:             if (engine is LineOcrEngine) engine.recognizeLine(crop) else engine.recognizeText(crop)
```
  (region list built fully before returning; no callback per box)
* Detection: `private fun detectionEngine(): DetOcrEngine` `:297`; `DetOcrEngine.detectTextRegions(image): List<OcrBoundingBox>` — `data/.../ocr/DetOcrEngine.kt:8` (`internal interface`), impls `UnavailableDetOcrEngine :13-18`, `CyrillicDetOcrEngine :30-34`.
* Per‑page engines (all `internal`, all return a complete list): `ZenFreeOcrEngine.recognizePage(image): List<OcrRegion>` `data/.../ocr/ZenFreeOcrEngine.kt:24` (+ `askAboutPage :100`, `postAndReadText :143`, `parseZenOcrRegions :249`, `"stream": false` at `:31`, `:107`); `GlensOcrEngine.recognizePage :53` (gRPC‑style protobuf, `GlensPageResult :705`); `OwOcrEngine.recognizePage :167` (OkHttp WebSocket `onMessage` at `:104` — the only push channel in OCR); `MlKitOcrEngine.recognizeRegions :46` (`MlKitRegion :89`).
* Line‑level contract: `data/.../ocr/OcrEngine.kt:9-21 internal interface OcrEngine { suspend fun recognizeText(Bitmap): String; fun close() }` and `:29-31 internal interface LineOcrEngine : OcrEngine { suspend fun recognizeLine(Bitmap): String }`.
* Text‑only engines collapse to a single whole‑page region: `scanWithTextEngine :568-600`; Zen/Glens/OwOcr per‑region mapping at `:602-627`, `:683-710`, `:712-742`; ML Kit `:637-681`; whole‑page rescue `:852-870`; promotional‑region filter `:899-906`.
* Result model: `domain/.../ocr/model/OcrModels.kt` — `OcrImage :3-14`, `OcrBoundingBox :16-31`, `OcrRegion(order, text, boundingBox, textOrientation) :38-57` (`isWholePage` `:52-56`), `OcrPageResult(regions) :59-69` (`text` getter joins all regions).
* Engine catalogue (for reference): `data/.../ocr/OcrPlugins.kt:67-158` — `cyrillic_ppocr`, `mlkit`, `google_lens`, `zen_free` ("Space Bunny Free (OpenCode Zen)"), `google_ai`, `openrouter`, `owocr`; `byModel(model)` `:173`.

**Summary for the streaming work:** the closest existing pattern to copy is `OcrStageBus` (global `StateFlow<Event>` posted from inside the data layer, collected in Compose) combined with `OcrChapterScanner`'s `onProgress` callbacks. For AI chat, the equivalent would be a per‑turn delta callback on `AiBackends.ChatFn` / `AiAgent.run` (which already has `onProgress`), driven by a new SSE reader in `AiAssistant.chatRawOutcome` (`AiAssistant.kt:482-579`) plus a delta parser next to `ZenProtocol.parse`, rendering into a placeholder `Msg` in `ReaderAiChatOverlay.history` (`:116`) instead of appending once at `:680`.

Repo: /home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code (Kotlin, Android manga reader "yomikai"/Mihon fork).

I need a "very thorough" analysis of TWO subsystems. Report exact file paths, function signatures, and line numbers.

## 1. AI chat history / sessions (for adding a separate roleplay session)

Read and report on:
- `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/ai/AiHistoryManager.kt` — full contents summary: the `Msg` data class fields, `load`, `append`, `clear` functions, how the file path is derived (is it per-mangaId? one file per manga? filename format?), and any trimming/limits.
- `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/ai/BookKnowledge.kt` — specifically `Session` class (if any), `ensureSession`, `load`, `save`, `render` functions, the `Book` data class fields, and the file naming for per-manga JSON.
- `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/ai/AiAgent.kt` — find the function that builds the `historyBlock` for the prompt (signature, params, how history is truncated/filtered/budgeted), and any place that computes a session id.
- `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/presentation/reader/components/ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt` — the composable parameters list (top ~120 lines), where `history` is declared/loaded/cleared, and where `sendMessage` is called.
- Anywhere that displays a chat/session history list or a "clear history" action, for both AI chat and general app (grep for `AiHistoryManager`, `clearHistory`, `deleteHistory`).

I need to know: to give roleplay its OWN history (separate from normal chat), what is the minimal change? Does the history file path include anything I could add a "mode" segment to? Is history keyed only by mangaId?

## 2. TTS (text-to-speech) pipeline (for voices, sighs, interjections)

Find and report on the TTS implementation, likely `app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/tts/`:
- `TtsSpeaker.kt` and any other files in that dir.
- For EACH file: what the public API is (classes, objects, functions, their signatures), and especially:
  - How text is PREPARED before being sent to the TTS engine. Look for any regex/cleanup that strips or transforms text: parentheses/brackets content (e.g. `(вздох)`, `[ааа]`, `*шёпотом*`), markdown, emoji, quotes, asterisks, underscores, ellipses, dashes.
  - Whether bracketed/parenthesized stage directions (emotional cues like "вздох", "ааа", "крик", "шёпот", "смеётся") are currently REMOVED or SPOKEN.
  - How the model/voice is selected per sentence or per message (pitch/rate/pan/volume controls if any).
  - Any per-character or per-speaker voice assignment (the AI knows characters, so voices may be assigned per character name).
  - Where TTS is invoked from the AI chat overlay (does the user long-press a message to read it aloud?).
- Also report what TTS engines/options exist (Android TTS? OpenAI-compatible? custom?) and whether pitch/rate/emphasis can be set per utterance.

Quote the exact regex or cleanup code you find, with file path and line numbers, so I can decide how to make interjections spoken instead of dropped.

Do NOT modify any files. This is research only. Return a detailed structured report.

Очень тщательно исследуй Android/Kotlin-репозиторий без изменений. Нужна точная карта для реализации требования: при первом AI/авточтении книги создаётся отдельная книжная AI-сессия; агент может сам найти/прочитать сайт или принять URL/текст от пользователя; изученные правила (порядок чтения, области/рамки, баблы/облачки, роли и голоса) сохраняются и применяются к OCR, авточтению, переводу и озвучке; OCR, чат и оркестратор должны выбираться раздельно и показываться. Найди и прочитай релевантные файлы: ReaderActivity/ViewModel, AutoReadEngine, AiAgent, AiChatTab/ReaderAiChatOverlay, AiHttpServer, BookKnowledge, BooksStore/Book models, OcrPreferences/Settings AI, AiBackends/AiChoices/AI history, web tools, voice resolver, DI. Верни: (1) точные пути и диапазоны строк ключевых функций/типов, (2) текущий поток вызовов при открытии книги и старте авточтения, (3) где уже есть bookId/знания/история и как их расширить минимальным изменением, (4) где выбираются и фактически вызываются модели OCR/chat/orchestrator, (5) точки UI для первого запуска/выбора URL и модели, (6) существующие тестовые паттерны и рекомендуемый безопасный план реализации с разбиением на небольшие коммиты. Не редактируй файлы, не запускай сборку и не коммить. Пиши по-русски, указывай ссылки file:line.

Проведи тщательное исследование кода репозитория без внесения изменений. Найди компоненты «читалки»/reader, взаимодействие AI со страницами книги, получение или обучение на данных из интернета, а также ручной ввод/обучение от пользователя. Проследи поток данных от UI до API/сервисов и обратно, найди связанные модели, промпты, провайдеры, endpoints, хранилища и тесты. Верни краткий, но конкретный отчёт на русском: архитектура, ключевые файлы с номерами строк, что уже реализовано, пробелы/неясности, и какие команды/тесты можно запустить для проверки. Не редактируй файлы и не коммить.
